name: How quickly does wet ceiling drywall need to be addressed?

mainEntity.name: How quickly does wet ceiling drywall need to be addressed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wet ceiling drywall should be addressed immediately. Water damage can spread rapidly, compromising structural integrity and encouraging mold growth within 24-48 hours. The longer it remains wet, the more extensive and costly the repairs will be. Early intervention minimizes damage and helps prevent secondary issues like mold remediation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wet ceiling drywall needs immediate attention to prevent rapid damage spread and mold growth, which can occur within 24-48 hours.
